channel.title: EA Hospitality Pulse
channel.description: Daily market intelligence for East Africa's hospitality and travel trade — Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zanzibar, Rwanda. Free to republish with attribution; see /republish.

item.title: Evening Wrap — Monday, 21 September 2026
item.description: We lead with analysis and say so.

item.title: Evening Wrap — Sunday, 20 September 2026
item.description: 1️⃣ YOUR POWER BILL FELL THIS MONTH. THE SAME GAZETTE ROUND CLOSED THE WAY OUT OF IT.

item.title: Sunday Foresight — Sunday, 20 September 2026
item.description: Uganda was declared Ebola-free on 25 August. Entebbe's August traffic still fell 29.1%. That is what a risk label costs — invoiced this week at 69,623 passengers.

item.title: Evening Wrap — Saturday, 19 September 2026
item.description: The US entry ban on Uganda is now printed law with a comment box attached. It closes 1 October.

item.title: Evening Wrap — Friday, 18 September 2026
item.description: Kenya's operators spent Thursday arguing about the price. The only argument with a deadline is about the process.

item.title: Morning Brief — Friday, 18 September 2026
item.description: Africa's hotels adopted AI faster than anywhere on earth. New data says that was the easy part.

item.title: Evening Wrap — Thursday, 17 September 2026
item.description: Paris closed tonight. East Africa leaves holding 2027 and 2028 prices, fixed against a cost base that moved twice this week.

item.title: Morning Brief — Thursday, 17 September 2026
item.description: Three inputs into your 2027 P&L moved overnight. None of them moved in East Africa.

item.title: Evening Wrap — Tuesday, 15 September 2026
item.description: Uganda has been Ebola-free for 86 days and is still banned. Here is the thing this industry keeps measuring wrong.

item.title: Morning Brief — Tuesday, 15 September 2026
item.description: Yesterday EPRA froze your fuel price. This week the routes it arrives by were cut.

item.title: Evening Wrap — Monday, 14 September 2026
item.description: Tomorrow's headline will be "fuel prices unchanged". Read the landed costs instead.

item.title: Evening Wrap — Sunday, 13 September 2026
item.description: This morning we said Washington now lists Uganda for what might happen. Tonight: a case has already made that journey.

item.title: Sunday Foresight — Sunday, 13 September 2026
item.description: Uganda is Ebola-free and still banned. On 11 September the reason changed — and the new one has no exit.

item.title: Evening Wrap — Saturday, 12 September 2026
item.description: 1️⃣ NAIROBI'S CBD IS OUT OF BOUNDS TOMORROW. THE PROCESSION FORMS AT ALL SAINTS.

item.title: Morning Brief — Friday, 11 September 2026
item.description: 1️⃣ FOUR STATISTICS OFFICES. ONE FINDING. YOUR BIGGEST INPUT IS INFLATING UP TO FIVE TIMES FASTER THAN YOUR ROOM RATE.

item.title: Evening Wrap — Thursday, 10 September 2026
item.description: 1️⃣ KENYA HAS ACTIVATED AN EL NIÑO CONTINGENCY PLAN FOR OCTOBER–DECEMBER. THAT IS YOUR SEASON.

item.title: Morning Brief — Thursday, 10 September 2026
item.description: 1️⃣ INDIGO HAS FILED THE MUMBAI–DAR SCHEDULE. DAILY FROM 20 NOVEMBER — AND IT LANDS AT 06:05.

item.title: Evening Wrap — Wednesday, 9 September 2026
item.description: 1️⃣ EXCLUSIVE — CANADA PUT KENYA ON ITS DENGUE WATCHLIST YESTERDAY. THE COUNTIES IT LANDS ON ARE MOMBASA AND KILIFI.

item.title: Evening Wrap — Tuesday, 8 September 2026
item.description: 1️⃣ EAST AFRICA NO LONGER HAS ONE COST BASE. RWANDA'S HOTEL PRICES ROSE 14.2% THIS YEAR. TANZANIA'S ROSE 2.7%.

item.title: Morning Brief — Tuesday, 8 September 2026
item.description: 1️⃣ WHO IS PROVISIONING 2,071 MORE EBOLA BEDS. THAT IS THE REAL CLOCK ON UGANDA'S LEVEL 4.

item.title: Evening Wrap — Sunday, 6 September 2026
item.description: A split now visible in South African itineraries that East Africa should expect to import.

item.title: Sunday Foresight — Sunday, 6 September 2026
item.description: You are now priced on the quality of your records, not your assets.

item.title: Evening Wrap — Saturday, 5 September 2026
item.description: Tonight, the Bill in committee that changes who collects your levy, who decides how it is spent, and who counts your guests.

item.title: Morning Brief — Saturday, 5 September 2026
item.description: Ethiopian Airlines has filed to more than double its Addis–Kilimanjaro–Zanzibar service from 30 November. We have not seen this reported anywhere in the East African trade press yet.

item.title: Morning Brief — Friday, 4 September 2026
item.description: Tanzania is still banned from EU skies. Much of the trade has been told otherwise for a year.

item.title: Morning Brief — Thursday, 3 September 2026
item.description: Uganda got its all-clear eight days ago. Washington hasn't noticed.

item.title: Evening Wrap — Tuesday, 1 September 2026
item.description: Tonight, the thing 26 days out that almost nobody here has diarised.

item.title: Morning Brief — Tuesday, 1 September 2026
item.description: The JKIA strike is over. Read the agreement, not the headline — it sets its own expiry date, and it falls in three weeks.

item.title: Sunday Foresight — Monday, 31 August 2026
item.description: This week's results all say the same thing: bigger top line, worse unit economics.

item.title: Morning Brief — Monday, 31 August 2026
item.description: JKIA is delayed, not closed — and that distinction is worth money to you today.
